guidedProject.title: 2048 Puzzle Game Engine
guidedProject.description:
Build 2048 from first principles instead of copying a finished game.

The project is intentionally divided into small milestones:
1. Understand the board as a 2D array.
2. Render a 4×4 grid.
3. Generate an empty cell.
4. Add a new tile.
5. Move a row left.
6. Merge adjacent equal numbers exactly once.
7. Apply movement to all four directions.
8. Calculate score.
9. Detect game over.
10. Add restart and keyboard controls.

Keep game logic as small pure helper functions wherever possible. React state stores the current board and score; event handlers dispatch movement logic and update state.
